title: Svelte Router New Tab
firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Open a new tab and follow the links to move between routes
Add a route under src/newtab/routes/ and it renders with no server
useCases: A multi-route new tab app with client-side routing
Hash routing with svelte-spa-router inside an extension page
Reference for routing with no server under MV3

store.summary: Replaces your new tab page with a small Svelte app you can navigate across routes.
versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the newtab-svelte-router template. Not yet submitted to any store.
